title: Rice-VL: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Cultural Understanding Across ASEAN Countries

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using the RICE-VL benchmark, which consists of cultural Visual Question Answering (VQA) and Cultural Visual Grounding tasks based on images of traditions, artifacts, and practices from Southeast Asian cultures. Model responses are scored using the SEA-LAVE metric to assess cultural appropriateness, textual relevance, and sub-culture identification.

Comparing model performance (VQA scores and bounding box Intersection over Union) across 11 distinct ASEAN countries to identify representation and accuracy gaps between high-resource nations (e.g., Singapore, Malaysia) and low-resource nations (e.g., Timor-Leste, Laos).
